messages:
jordan: noticed the cost dashboard showing negative cache savings for a couple tenants after last canary :confused:
kai: yep, t-893 and t-441. looks like prefetch credits doubled up in the rollup
maria: can you paste a sample? timeframe and batch id?
jordan: sample: tenant t-893, window 2026-03-17T00:00..2026-03-18T00:00, rollup batch backfill-20260317
alex: that backfill job emits credits tagged as "prefetch:backfill". our rollup groups credits by type and sums, so backfill + live prefetch both counted
kai: backend charge calc is too naive. need to canonicalize credit lineage before summing
paul: quick mitigation: dedupe credits by (origin_id, request_signature) within 24h. should stop duplicates from backfill
nori: careful—some workflows legitimately have multiple credits (prefetch then rebate). we need a precedence rule rather than blind dedupe
paul: propose precedence: backfill < prefetch < rebate. implement in rollup and surface precedence reason in UI
maria: dashboard work: 1) fix rollup dedupe, 2) add an explain row for negative-net tenants listing top contributing credits and provenance
ops-bot: deploy pipeline: job "billing-rollup" failed on canary-3 2h ago -- https://ci.internal/reports/6821
alex: that job is the backfill. i'll patch rollup to dedupe origin_id and add a debug flag to dump raw credit events
jordan: UX idea: per-tenant sparkline hover shows token-burn, cache-savings, backfill-credits, model-sku cost. add a "counterfactual" toggle that shows cost if prefetch credits were not applied
kai: backend API sketch:
GET /internal/v1/cost-preview?tenant=t-893&window=24h&counterfactual=prefetch
Response: { "token_cost": 12345, "cache_savings": -4000, "prefetch_credits": 4500, "counterfactual_net": 7845 }
alex: prefer explicit numeric fields and a provenance array for the UI to explain negatives
maria: provenance array but limit to top 10 and aggregate the rest into an "others" bucket to keep payloads small
paul: remember sampling: some tenants are 10% sampled for econ panels. extrapolation of credits must be careful so counterfactuals aren't noisy
nori: also add per-model tail-cost column; certain model variants have high tail token overhead that skews per-route averages
jordan: include per-model avg token cost and a 95p latency tax so teams see hidden tail costs
kai: rollout UX: when a model is canaried, the preview slider should show projected unit-cost delta at current traffic and at 5%/20% splits
maria: product also wants a certainty badge (green/orange/red) based on sample size and last-rollup age. red if <200 invocations or last rollup >12h
ori: payload size concern: make provenance opt-in via ?detail=provenance (default minimal)
paul: +1 and add sampling_version header so clients don't break when we iterate
alex: PoC branch: /internal/cost-preview v0.2 includes provenance + counterfactual + detail param. will add tests and feature flag
jordan: canary plan: roll to canary-2 with debug for 2h, capture screenshots, then roll fix to canary-3 where backfill ran
kai: checklist:
- rollup dedupe by origin_id (paul)
- sampling_version header + extrapolation doc (maria)
- cost-preview API v0.2 (alex)
- UI explain row + counterfactual toggle + certainty badge (jordan, product)
- validate tenants t-893, t-441, t-1023 in canary
maria: timeline: hotfix today, full rollout tomorrow if canary looks good
paul: opening rollup PR now and marking urgent
jordan: thanks. post screenshots here after canary so we can confirm negatives resolved :thumbsup:
alex: PR #8245 opened https://git.internal/p/r/redwood/billing/8245
ops-bot: PR #8245 merged into canary-2 by alex (ci: green)
kai: running debug canary, reporting back in ~30m
maria: support blurb draft: "We observed duplicate prefetch credits due to a backfill job; impact was on displayed cache-saving numbers only. We deployed a fix to deduplicate credits; billing charged to customers is unaffected."
jordan: saving blurb to /snippets/support/cache_credit_backfill.md
paul: post-fix t-893 shows cache_savings 0 -> 420 and no negative net cost in 24h panel
nori: nice. closing once canary is green and certainty badges turn green for sampled tenants
alex: celebration beer emoji \ud83c\udf7a
